author: mark
text:
UI: git-tree renderer for v0.2-shape repos

Extends lernie-ui-egui's git_tree module from v0.1-shape (flat linear
history with top-level exchanges/<id>.json) to v0.2-shape (ex/<ts>-<id>
branches with --no-ff merges back to main per ARCH §2.3, §2.6).

View-model additions: GitTree gains in_flight (exchange branches not
yet reached from main); CommitNode gains steps (for a merge commit,
the first-parent chain on the exchange branch reachable from the
second parent). Module-split to stay under the 300-line cap.
